column7: DC input voltage with slow filter.

column15: bit 0 = Reset; bit 1 = Over-current; bit 3 = Software; bit 4 = HVD; bit 5 = Hot (heatsink over 95 °C); bit 6 = DIP switch; bit 7 = Settings edit

column7: Alarms do not stop the inverter.
column15: bit 0 = Heatsink sensor open; bit 1 = Heatsink sensor shorted; bit 3 = Heatsink hot (above 80 °C)
bit 0 = DIP 1 on; bit 1 = DIP 2 on; bit 2 = DIP 3 on; bit 3 = DIP 4 on
0 = Start-up; 1 = Load on; 2 = LVD warning; 3 = LVD; 4 = Fault; 5 = Load disconnected (by meter/Modbus); 6 = Load off; 8 = Standby

column7: Non-zero turns the AC output off; write 0 to resume.
Non-zero resets the inverter; returns to 0.
